replayAuthority: vendor/cc-switch/output-inventory.json and its existing exact-byte JSON recipes
generation: Read immutable Git objects, preserve complete selected trees, three-way merge source outputs in core, then record the reviewed candidate. Never execute candidate capture/sync/build scripts to authorize a generation.
dependencyPolicy: New files inside selected trees are included. Dependencies outside selection require exact --approve-source paths; unresolved resources or computed expressions remain blockers. Host locks are never replaced by upstream locks.
crossForkPolicy: OpenHands inventory hostBuildInputs and resource-closure inputs are read-only consumers, including snapshot-only CC files. A changed or deleted consumed input produces BLOCKED_CROSS_FORK; never recapture the other fork.
derivedPolicy: Each derived output keeps its original source identity. A changed source requires --reviewed-derived for the exact output after semantic review; the existing exact-byte recipe then records that port without claiming runtime acceptance.

adapters.reason: Native Home/data paths and registered targets come from host_context, not ambient operator Home. Restoring upstream fallback would grant unintended filesystem authority.
adapters.acceptance: Run isolated context and native-path authorization tests; preserve explicit unbound-target failures and private-file handling.
adapters.removeWhen: The selected upstream exposes equivalent explicit context and path authorization seams adopted by the host.

adapters.reason: Headless MCP DAO must open/seal credential-bearing definitions with the host secret codec instead of plaintext SQLite serialization.
adapters.acceptance: Run secret codec/DAO round-trip and redaction tests using disposable keys only.
adapters.removeWhen: Upstream supplies an equivalent encrypted storage seam and reviewed data compatibility is demonstrated.

adapters.reason: Host assignments, per-agent option overrides, validation-before-write and partial/unknown sync outcomes are required; configuration persistence is not native sync success.
adapters.acceptance: Run assignment/override rollback and isolated native projection tests across the supported application matrix.
adapters.removeWhen: Upstream and host share equivalent assignment, validation and observable partial-success semantics.

adapters.reason: fork-policy.derivedOutputs records the GUI-free Codex helpers as a real derivation of codex_config.rs; a new upstream input must be reviewed, not mistaken for a local file or overwritten from a same-name upstream path.
adapters.acceptance: Review the full source diff and run isolated Codex configuration IO/validation tests before full verification.
adapters.removeWhen: Upstream exposes a directly reusable headless module preserving the registered path contract.
